sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Burning Rubber is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Looking for a job, you say? I have a little thing to take care of... I got a buddy who drives people around in his SUV from the city center, where that blue boom happened. For cash, obviously! You have to whisper something in his ear, but do it during your trip, so that no scum can overhear you. I won't trust you with anything very secret, don't even dream of it, but I don't want any rumors to spread. Job's easy enough, I'll even give you the money for the ride. You up for it?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Use the paid vehicle extraction on Ground Zero

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.1
- 450 Euros
  - 472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Alright, the guy told me you showed up and did everything fine."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Roubles | 20,000 | Required to pay the driver for the extraction. |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to extract from Ground Zero via the "Police Cordon V-Ex" extraction with the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status. By default the fee amount is 20,000 Roubles, but it can be higher or lower depending on your Scav karma.
